supersession: Latest Operator correction supersedes previous D264/D266 retirement and D346/D347 child_of link-removal previews in d264-retirement-closure-20261105. They have no effect and must not be applied. Keep D264/D266.
decision: Header.Container is one mapping with exactly one key: scope_unit or atom. A scope_unit value uses the stable Scope Unit ID only. Carrier placement follows the corresponding Scope Unit or containing Atom folder; the direct IS_CONTAINED_BY view derived from the nearest eligible Directory Carrier resolves to the same declared container ID, not another authored fact.
integration_holds: Existing R2508@7 and R2779@1 Drafts still express scalar Container and world bootstrap; coordinate a reviewed rebase to the settled exactly-one-key mapping and Scope Unit ID-only value before adoption. Project root/bootstrap encoding remains a separate pending decision.
The word Atom in the mapping means an admitted Atom reference; this packet does not establish a versioned-reference format or any Run Property. Formal Run parentage remains separately pending.
Preserve existing D346/D347 child_of links; prior retirement/link-removal candidates are superseded, not applied.
Preserve Header.Relations other entries; no second authored IS_CONTAINED_BY, no new graph entity or Carrier-to-Carrier relation.
Placement readback is not independently authoritative over Header.Container or Project Structure. No physical folder moves or runtime validation occur here.
limits: Whole-content proposals preserve each source Summary, active Subject, identity, status, version and metadata exactly. D266@30/D268@31 are prospective rebases of existing Drafts, not new native writes.
scope_unit_value_boundary: Use stable Scope Unit IDs only; paths and label decorations are not accepted as the scope_unit value.
